items.headline: Rip Current Statement issued September 8 at 2:38AM EDT until September 8 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Wilmington NC
items.description:
* WHAT...Dangerous rip currents expected. A strong north to south
longshore current is also expected.

* WHERE...In North Carolina, Coastal Pender and Coastal New
Hanover Counties. In South Carolina, Coastal Georgetown County.

* WHEN...Today.

* IMPACTS...Rip currents can sweep even the best swimmers away
from shore into deeper water.
items.instruction:
Swim near a lifeguard. If caught in a rip current, relax and
float. Don't swim against the current. If able, swim in a
direction following the shoreline. If unable to escape, face the
shore and call or wave for help.
